propositions: A per-CI-run NDJSON snapshot persists point-in-time code-health metrics (coverage %, complexity distribution, clone count) so their trend can accumulate.
write_snapshot appends a timestamped record and read_snapshots yields records within a since/until range, round-tripping written data.
A malformed or truncated NDJSON line must be skipped without raising, and the reader still returns the valid records.
The snapshot store must live at the git-tracked path .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson, requiring a gitignore negation to un-ignore it under the blanket .rebar/* rule.
Placing the snapshot under gitignored reports/ would prevent it from being committed, so the trend series would silently never persist.
Until a snapshot exists, trend metrics report unavailable.
